title: Successor compatibility of normalized ordinary pullback levels
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, a scheme map $f:X\to Y$, an ordinary quotient model $M$ [def-trf-completion-unit-models], and a cochain complex $P$ of completed-coefficient module sheaves. Let $T$ be termwise sequence inverse image followed by completed scalar restriction and transposition to towers [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems] [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models]. Suppose isomorphisms $e_n:T(M(P))_n\xrightarrow{\sim}B_f(P)_n$ with the defining integral finite pullback tower [def-a1-integral-finite-pullback-tower] send every sequence-unit generator at $(n,U)$ to the finite pullback unit generator of its $M.\mathrm{evaluation}_n$ image, in every degree $i\in\mathbf Z$. Then these isomorphisms intertwine every successor transition: $T(M(P))(n+1\to n);e_n=e_{n+1};B_f(P)(n+1\to n)$. The level isomorphisms and their generator equations are given; the conclusion asserts their successor compatibility.

proof.text: For a completed-coefficient module A, compose the unit of M.adjunction with each ordinary limit projection to obtain maps a_n:A→Res_n M(A)_n. These form a compatible cone by limit.w. Read their sections as original sequence sections using integralComparisonRestrictedSectionType. Their images through M.evaluation are precisely 1 tensor x by M.unit_tensor. Naturality of the sequence inverse-image unit along a horizontal sequence-site arrow and the sectionwise characterization of coefficientSequenceRestriction show that the pulled-back generators of these cone sections also form a compatible sequence.

In each degree conjugate the source successor by e_(n+1) inverse and e_n. Equality of completed-linear maps out of the higher finite pullback can be tested on finite pullback unit generators of 1 tensor x. Indeed, local surjectivity of the completed projection makes these maps finite-linear after restricting the target along finite reduction. The finite pullback adjunction and the scalar-reduction adjunction successively reduce equality to those generators. The existing scalarUnit_tensor normalization from the proved coherent ordinary reconstruction module identifies the latter adjunction unit with 1 tensor x.

The normalization hypothesis sends the compatible pulled-back cone generators of the first step to the finite pullback generators of 1 tensor x. Thus the conjugated source successor sends the higher such generator to the lower one. The published finite pullback transition does the same by its generator equation and the pure-tensor formula for unrestrictedIntegralTransition, since coefficient reduction preserves 1. The extensionality of the second step identifies the conjugated maps, and cancellation of the level isomorphism proves the original successor square. This is degreewise and uses no boundedness or flatness.

theorem ordinaryQuotientPullback_successor {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E Y)
    (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E Y) ℤ) :
    let T := (integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      (coefficientSequenceRestriction l E X).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      HomologicalComplex.complexOfFunctorsToFunctorToComplex
    ∀ (e : ∀ n : ℕ, (T.obj ((M.quotient l E Y).obj P)).obj (op n) ≅
        ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P).obj (op n)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ) (U : Y.ProEt)
        (x : (M.tensor.obj (P.X i)).val.obj (op (n, U))),
        (((e n).hom.f i).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U)))
          (integralComparisonRestrictedSection l E X
            ((integralComparisonSequencePullback l E f).obj (M.tensor.obj (P.X i))) n
            (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj U))
            (integralComparisonSequenceGenerator l E f (M.tensor.obj (P.X i)) n U x)) =
          integralOperationsPullbackGenerator l E f n
            ((scalarReductionExtension l E Y n).obj (P.X i)) U
            (((M.evaluation n).hom.app (P.X i)).val.app (op U)
              (coefficientEvaluationSection l E Y (M.tensor.obj (P.X i)) n (op U) x))) →
      ∀ n : ℕ,
        (T.obj ((M.quotient l E Y).obj P)).map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op ≫
            (e n).hom =
          (e (n + 1)).hom ≫
            ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E f).obj P).map
              (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op
